claim_being_audited: That certifying the model is compliant only if the certification explicitly discloses the unresolved small-business support weakness, because aggregate performance passes the deployment threshold but no approved mitigation removes the subgroup exposure.
specific_concerns: The admissible record available to this role is only the Actor's summary plus cited evidence IDs; the underlying contents of BMCARD-030-A through BMCARD-030-E are not available for independent verification.
The Actor makes precise quantitative claims about aggregate and slice performance, but the underlying model-card metrics, threshold definitions, and calculations are not in evidence here.

The Actor asserts there is 'no approved mitigation in the admissible record,' but the approval status and contents of the referenced mitigation record cannot be independently checked from the materials available to this role.
The policy text supports the Actor's general reasoning, but it does not by itself establish that this specific slice issue is in fact a disclosed material weakness on the underlying record.
Because this is a one-shot assignment with actor_summary_only access, the packet is directionally plausible but overstates evidentiary support for a firm compliance conclusion.
unsupported_claims: The model clears the aggregate deployment threshold by exactly 2.2 percentage points.
The small-business support slice is exactly 1.1 points below its warning threshold and 2.6 points below its preferred threshold.
There is no approved mitigation in the admissible record.
The cited sample-size note supports the stated uncertainty characterization for this specific slice.
evidence_requests: Provide the contents of BMCARD-030-A through BMCARD-030-E, especially the model-card metrics, subgroup results, threshold definitions, and any approval or mitigation records.
Provide the document or excerpt that establishes the small-business support slice as a material weakness requiring disclosure.
Provide the approval status and text of the draft post-launch monitoring proposal or any other mitigation artifact.
Provide the sampling/statistical note supporting the claim of wider uncertainty for the small-business support slice.
decision_criteria: If the cited evidence shows the aggregate metric exceeds the deployment threshold, that the small-business support slice remains below relevant thresholds, and that certification includes explicit disclosure of that weakness, the action could be compliant.
If any approved mitigation in the record removes deployment exposure, disclosure may still matter, but the Actor's rationale would need to be revised to rely on that approval rather than its absence.
If the underlying record does not support the numeric threshold claims, the material-weakness characterization, or the absence of approved mitigation, the action would move toward noncompliant.
Policy permits certification with disclosure of material weaknesses; it does not permit aggregate performance alone to erase subgroup weakness.
